provenance.origin: already-interpreted findings summarised from the cited papers; tests judgment over supplied summaries, NOT reproduction from raw data

program: FOS / JUN / JUNB / EGR1 immediate-early-gene program
in_vitro_finding: Strongly induced in cells profiled by scRNA-seq after enzymatic dissociation at 37 °C; appears as a discrete 'stressed' cell state / subpopulation.
in_vivo_finding: Absent when the same tissue is profiled without warm dissociation (snapshot in situ, snRNA-seq, or cold-active protease); the 'state' is a procedural artifact.
patient_finding: Same artifact in human tumour and tissue scRNA-seq when collagenase-dissociated; not a disease state.
